profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Computer Engineering graduate with experience working with web development and robotics. I have experience in web applications in Java and a familiarity with both aspects of front-end and back-end development.

positions.title: Learning Assistant
positions.description:
•	Teach Java to beginner programming students.
•	Lead labs to aid students in understanding Java and object-oriented programming concepts. 
•	Communicate effectively with students on debugging problems in their code and good coding   practices.
•	Weekly meetings to discuss changes and future plans.

positions.title: Robotics Teacher
positions.description:
•	Collaborated with 3 other teachers to create and adapt programming lectures for students ages 8-18. 
•	Built and programmed a robot that moved autonomously using an Arduino microcontroller.
•	Improved lectures to keep student’s engagement based on feedback.

company.name: Florida International University - College of Engineering & Computing

positions.title: Bridge to Success Student Engineer
positions.description:
•	Planned and developed an underwater rover.
•	Analyzed unfamiliar problems with design and movement and resolved them through teamwork.
•	Created documentation detailing the steps of creation, issues, and future improvements.
•	Used Arduino to transform the robot to work autonomously.

company.name: Florida International University - College of Engineering & Computing

projects.title: Trip Manager
projects.description: This project is meant to handle trips from the user and save them to a MySQL database. The user adds a trip location and some info then can view the trip to place locations to visit. The locations will be obtainable through the Google Places API so that reviews and information can be seen while viewing the location. The project is a work in progress.

projects.title: Password Hasher
projects.description: An android application meant to create hashes out of a password entered. The time to create is then compared in a bar graph to compare with other hashes to see the fastest. Lastly, an implementation with the haveibeenpwned API to determine if your password has been exposed in various data breaches
